symptom: CE7375 "must be published and be the key when associations are exposed as an associated object id" on a service publishing no associations
cause: `PublishAssociations` is the representation, not a yes/no — `No` selects "as an associated object id", which needs the system ID as key
insight: Set `PublishAssociations: Yes` ("as a link", and the default when omitted). MDL-ODATA06 warns at check time
